text: ポケモンに　みずぎの　おしり　かみ　ちぎられ　ちゃって　あがれないのよう

structure.jp: みずぎの　おしり　かみ　ちぎられ　ちゃって
structure.en: the seat of my swimsuit got bitten off, and so

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ポケモンに　みずぎの　おしり　かみ　ちぎられ
words: かみちぎられちゃって
patterns.explanation: られ in the verb says the thing was done to you, and に shows who did it. ポケモンに　かみちぎられ = 'got bitten off by a Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: ちぎられ　ちゃって
words: かみちぎられちゃって
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual form of てしまう, which says something happened completely and you are unhappy about it. Its て-form here also gives the reason for what follows. ちぎられちゃって = 'it went and got torn off, so'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb's ending to れる turns 'do' into 'can do', and ない makes it 'cannot'. あがれない = 'can't get out'.
